layout_requirements: Keep board positions clear of central Y-16..14 corridor for switch tail.
Do not fill entire electronics-board bounding rectangle with a solid high shelf: preserve central cable drop X48..72/Y-12..12.
Converter ears on two isolated support pads, metal body open to air; avoid insulating its entire base.
Hub and charge interface are mounted to removable rear module; unplug hub USB before cover removal.
Preserve IMU origin(0,0,85), bridge and leg interfaces.
Do not equate cable envelope checks with verified bend-radius, electrical suitability or current rating.
